description: Crude and fully adjusted standardised risk ratios (all blocks; all blocks except light) under the NHTSA-imputed fatal outcome and the complete-case fatal outcome (fatal_cc), with the ratio of the two RRs and the share of the crude log-RR retained under each
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with a determinable NHTSA-imputed maximum severity (MAXSEV_IM 0-4)
method: Survey-weighted logistic models (exposure + every subset of covariate blocks; ridge 0.01 on mean-1 weights; exact cell compression); standardised predictive margins over all crashes; risk ratio = margin(all exposed) / margin(all reference); Taylor-linearised influence summed within 67 PSUs / 25 strata, t with 42 df; shares and Shapley values by the delta method across models; the complete-case models use the crashes whose complete-case outcome is determined
